verdict.rationale: Dialpad documents a broad API surface that covers many UI-level actions: admin access-control policies, contact anonymization, recording and AI-data removal, company-wide number blocking, adding call participants, and assigning contact-center operators. It also offers webhooks, websocket events, OAuth and a Python client. However, nothing in the evidence states or demonstrates full UI parity. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim or coverage map, evidence covering meetings, messaging, AI agents and coaching features (Listen/Barge/Take Over) via the API, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: With powerful APIs, unlock the amazing capabilities of the Dialpad platform to build feature rich applications.
Creates a new custom access control policy. Requires a company admin API key.
Blocks the given phone numbers company-wide, so that inbound calls and texts from them are rejected for every user in the company.
Adds another participant to a call. Valid methods to add are by phone or by target.
Assigns an operator to a call queued in a contact center.
